title: Repossession Expenses and Personal Property Hold (Kestrel Advantage Balloon)
content:
**Status.** A repossession expense on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be charged only while the contract status is assigned for repossession or repossessed.

**Expenses.**

| Expense | When charged |
|---|---|
| Agency fee | The tier's involuntary agency fee for an involuntary recovery; the tier's voluntary agency fee for a voluntary surrender |
| Transport fee | Only on an involuntary recovery, at the tier's transport fee |
| Condition report fee | Once per repossession, at the tier's condition report fee |
| Storage | The tier's daily storage charge for each day the vehicle is stored beyond the tier's free days, counting from the repossession date to the release or sale date; billed when the vehicle leaves the lot |

The storage charge is the daily storage charge times the storage days less the free days, never below zero. Expenses are booked to fees due and become part of any reinstatement, redemption or deficiency amount.

**Personal property.** Personal property found in the vehicle is inventoried and held free of charge; the customer may collect it in person or have it shipped at the carrier's cost. Personal property may be disposed of only after the tier's hold days have fully elapsed from the date the vehicle was repossessed. The hold is counted in calendar days starting the day after the repossession date; disposal is permitted from the calendar day after the repossession date plus the hold days.

## Hold boundary (hypothetical, 15 hold days)

Repossession on the 1st of a month: the hold runs from the 2nd through the 16th; disposal on the 16th is not permitted and on the 17th is permitted.

## Hypothetical storage

Stored 2 days with 3 free days: no storage charge. Stored 10 days: 7 chargeable days times the daily charge.
